title: 15Oct-Valedictory & Nation Builder-News-Coverage
summary: 15th October - Valedictory Function & Prize Distribution and Nation Builder Awards 2026 to 12 Teachers (6 from Mumbai and 6 from Satara) at Bahai Centre.
description:
15th October - Valedictory Function & Prize Distribution and Nation Builder Awards 2026 to 12 Teachers (6 from Mumbai and 6 from Satara) at Bahai Centre.
The Youth Month celebrations culminated on 15th October with a Valedictory Event at Aryan High School, Girgaum which was graced by DG Rtn. Rajan Dua as Chief Guest and PDG Rtn Nitin Mangaldas.
The programme received excellent coverage across both print and digital media, giving our Club’s work wonderful visibility and recognition.
